images.alt_text: Diagram of a joint: two bones, the cartilage on their ends, and the lining and fluid around them.
images.credit: OpenStax College, Anatomy & Physiology. CC BY 3.0, via Wikimedia Commons. Resized.
images.why: Shows what a joint is before explaining inflammation in it.

images.alt_text: A doctor talking with a patient in a clinic room.
images.credit: National Cancer Institute, National Institutes of Health. Public domain, via Wikimedia Commons. Resized.
images.why: Friendly picture for lessons about talking with the care team.

images.alt_text: Picture of a person lying on the table of an MRI scanner.
images.credit: Blausen Medical Communications, Inc. CC BY 3.0, via Wikimedia Commons. Resized.
images.why: Shows what one of the imaging tests looks like.

images.alt_text: Diagram of the eye with the part called the uvea labeled.
images.credit: Courtesy: National Eye Institute, National Institutes of Health (NEI/NIH). Public domain, via Wikimedia Commons. Resized.
images.why: Shows the part of the eye where uveitis happens.

images.alt_text: Diagram of the digestive system, including the small and large intestine.
images.credit: Blausen.com staff (2014). "Medical gallery of Blausen Medical 2014". WikiJournal of Medicine 1(2). CC BY 3.0, via Wikimedia Commons. Resized.
images.why: Shows where the gut is for lessons on bowel changes.

images.alt_text: Diagram of the shoulder joint with its bones and lining labeled.
images.credit: Blausen.com staff (2014). "Medical gallery of Blausen Medical 2014". WikiJournal of Medicine 1(2). CC BY 3.0, via Wikimedia Commons. Resized.

images.alt_text: Diagram of the bones of the hand and wrist.
images.credit: Blausen.com staff (2014). "Medical gallery of Blausen Medical 2014". WikiJournal of Medicine 1(2). CC BY 3.0, via Wikimedia Commons. Resized.
images.why: Shows the small joints of the hand and wrist.

images.alt_text: Diagram of a fingertip showing the parts of the nail.
images.credit: Blausen.com staff (2014). "Medical gallery of Blausen Medical 2014". WikiJournal of Medicine 1(2). CC BY 3.0, via Wikimedia Commons. Resized.
images.why: Shows the nail parts behind nail changes.

images.alt_text: Diagram of the foot and ankle, with the Achilles tendon and ankle joint labeled.
images.credit: Blausen.com staff (2014). "Medical gallery of Blausen Medical 2014". WikiJournal of Medicine 1(2). CC BY 3.0, via Wikimedia Commons. Resized.
images.why: Shows the heel, Achilles tendon, ankle and mid-foot.

images.alt_text: Diagram of a person’s back with the lower spine highlighted.
images.credit: Blausen.com staff (2014). "Medical gallery of Blausen Medical 2014". WikiJournal of Medicine 1(2). CC BY 3.0, via Wikimedia Commons. Resized.
images.why: Shows where the lower spine is.

images.alt_text: Drawing of the pelvis with the two sacroiliac joints outlined in red.
images.credit: Henry Vandyke Carter, Gray’s Anatomy (1918). Public domain, via Wikimedia Commons. Resized.
